 `AgentEvent` is a single, serializable enum spanning lifecycle, raw deltas, post-aggregation semantic items, transitions, control signals, and terminal outcomes. The variants:

### Spec Compliance
Compliant. The diff adds the book paragraph and the "### Upgrade notes" section (3 bullets) to both CHANGELOGs under `## [Unreleased]`. I found no missing requirement. Steps 3 to 5 of the brief (release-plz check, mdbook, markdownlint) are not part of the diff, so I did not check them.

### Strengths
- Named risk (a): the claim is correct. `ErrorKindPayload::from_agent_error` maps every unlisted variant to `Other { message: e.to_string() }` (crates/paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal/src/error.rs:117-130). `driver.rs:225-226` applies it to `LoopState::Failed`. `error.rs:54-56` turns the payload into `RunError::Agent(AgentError::Other(..))` via `into_agent_error` (error.rs:137-155). "Arrives as `AgentError::Other` with the same text" is therefore true. The call chain shows `ToolCallsNotRun` falls into the `_` arm.
- Named risk (b): the procedure name exists. `crates/paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal/src/lib.rs:330` has the heading `# Upgrade Discipline and Determinism`. The core CHANGELOG correctly names the crate in its reference. The temporal CHANGELOG says "the crate docs", which is correct there.
- Named risk (c): the format matches the existing sections. Each one is `### Upgrade notes` followed by a blank line and "-" bullets, for example core CHANGELOG lines 44-49. The new section sits directly under `## [Unreleased]` (core CHANGELOG.md:8-14). I saw no mismatch.
- Named risk (d): the book paragraph (docs/book/src/concepts/agent-loop.md:~55) does not claim that usage is reported.
